scope: B1 flowers, prop surfaces, tenant walls, suspended ceiling and concourse services

references.name: Mayra's Bridal Pink garden rose
references.author: Alexandra Farms
references.license: Copyrighted photo: visual reference only, not redistributed in the game
references.observed: Downloaded photo inspected: overlapping rounded/scalloped cup petals, pale outer petals and darker nested centre. Official page lists a 12 cm rosette bloom.
references.interpretation: Original low-poly game rose approximates overlap and cup depth; not an exact botanical cultivar reconstruction.
references.not_confirmed: Current Korean shop stock, exact stem dimensions or scan geometry

references.name: KCC Mitone Sky commercial ceiling installation
references.author: KCC
references.observed: Inspected installation photograph shows ceiling profiles, suspended panel/baffle rhythm, metal mesh sections, hanging services and track/linear fixtures. Photograph depicts a library interior, not a verified supermarket.
references.interpretation: Grid, panel thickness, service mounts and recessed vents used as construction cues for an original basement fitout. The 600 mm game grid, duct sizes and maintenance marks are design choices.
references.not_confirmed: Actual Homeplus ceiling system, floor plan, dimensions or fire/sprinkler compliance

references.name: SNOWFOX FLOWERS store reference, reused
references.author: Snowfox Flowers
references.observed: Stepped buckets, grouped cut flowers, wrapped bouquet display and individual cards, visually inspected in preceding pass.

assets.name: Painted Plaster Wall
assets.author: Amal Kumar / Poly Haven
assets.location: B1 tenant upper wall finish and maintenance patch
assets.modifications: Existing project 2K maps reused, green/beige material tint, reduced normal strength 0.30; physical mesh UVs. Original scan is an exterior plaster, adapted as game interior material.
assets.compatibility: Unity 6000.6.8f1, URP 17.6 Lit; existing imported normal map reused. No pipeline setting change.

assets.name: Rose/gerbera heads, botanical leaves and bouquet sleeve variations
assets.author: Original project-authored geometry and procedural textures
assets.license: Original project work; no third-party mesh imported
assets.modifications: 20 cupped rose petals or 30 narrow gerbera petals combined per head, curved asymmetric leaves, subtle petal fibre/leaf veins, varying flower tilt/size and three folded paper sleeves. Head meshes <= 1200 vertices for existing sector batching. Petal shadow casting disabled to avoid thin-surface shadow-bias artifacts; stems, leaves and vessels retain shadows.

assets.name: B1 timber, clay, enamel, paper, ceiling and maintenance finishes
assets.author: Original procedural project textures and meshes
assets.location: B1 florist props, sewing equipment, six tenant walls/ceilings and central/service corridors
assets.modifications: Shared mipmapped texture families. Static room meshes combine ceiling panels/grid. Concourse ceiling split into seven 12 m sectors. Vents, service hatch, fixed conduits, sprinkler shapes, wall skirting/joints and restrained water tide marks. No new point/spot lights, gameplay interaction, per-flower update loop or network objects.

not_claimed: A scan-accurate real store, exact L4D2 rendering, fire code design, complete asset quality parity, or full AI/multiplayer performance validation.
